hero.title:
Feet in the sand,
drink in hand.
hero.lede: A little beach bar on the Passeig Voramar, where the terrace ends and the Mediterranean begins. Cold drinks, good food, sunbeds, and nowhere to be.

about.title:
A guingueta is a small bar by the water.
This one is ours.
about.p1: Step off the Passeig Voramar and the pavement turns to sand. Kiwi Guingueta sits right where the beach begins — a thatched-roof bar with a terrace, a few sunbeds for hire, and a line of sight straight out to sea.
about.p2: Come for a coffee in the morning, stay for a long lunch, and let the afternoon turn into cocktails. Children run about, dogs are welcome, and nobody hurries you along.

highlights.title: Everything you need for a day by the sea
highlights.f1Text: Tables on the sand, shade overhead, sea in front.
highlights.f2Text: Rent a bed at the bar and get full access to the beach.
highlights.f3Text: Beer, wine and cocktails, mixed the way you like them.
highlights.f4Text: Now and then, someone brings a guitar.
highlights.f5Text: Bring the dog. Bring the children too.
highlights.f6Text: Room to spread out, and a table big enough.
